findings.note: Ottawa's likely No. 1 goalie, Linus Ullmark, is 11-1-0 with a 1.47 GAA and .937 SV%. Ottawa won the Oct. 21 meeting 5-1 and is 7-1-2 in its last 10 games, while Florida is 5-4-1 with Markstrom at an .894 SV%.

Coach Paul Maurice said Barkov and Marchand are only 'possible' to return. A decision depends on medical clearance and is due on game day, and Florida has allowed 3.05 goals per game without Barkov, so check the confirmed lineup.
A Covers analyst picks the Florida Panthers moneyline and expects a low-scoring Panthers win, citing Barkov and Marchand's possible return. The analyst also expects Ullmark's form to come back down.
